title: ChristmasPresents
description: This plugin adds a simple present system to any server! You can add custom presents and a player can redeem them one time.
body:
**This plugin adds a simple system to allow users to gain presents!**

![/createpresent command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55b9164dccdbedbf4baa77cc26918518e9bcb01d.png)

![/present result](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/314e238e151c386f2d3c512c9c7fe549ccb0faa9.png)

## The commands are:

- /togglepresents [true|false] - enables or disables /present
- /createpresent - adds the items in the sender's mainhand to the list of presents
- /present - if togglepresents = true, give the player a random present from the list and adds them to the redeemed list
- /resetpresents - resets the list of players that have gotten a present
